title: Call out storage-as-received constraint implications for AV/transforms
description: Lines 141-144 require servers to store blob content exactly as received and prohibit transform-before-storage. This implicitly bans server-side virus scanning that modifies content, image transcoding, metadata stripping, etc. These are real deployment patterns. The spec should explicitly name what is prohibited so implementers don't discover the constraint by accident: add 'This includes any antivirus or content-filtering transforms that alter bytes.'
close_reason: Added explicit sentence naming antivirus, content-filtering, transcoding, and metadata-stripping as covered by the MUST NOT advertise clause.
